description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Karman Industries is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to develop and release embedded software for energy conversion hardware and integrate it with the Karman HPU. The role focuses on power-conversion controls and software across the system, from bootloader and drivers to real-time control, diagnostics, and release processes.
Embedded Software Engineer developing full-stack software, real-time control, and PWM strategies for LV/MV power conversion systems

Responsibilities:
• Write production embedded software for LV and MV power conversion systems
• Develop full stack embedded software including bootloader, complex IC drivers for power and communication, real-time control, protection, diagnostics, flight recorder, security, etc
• Develop advanced digital controls, including sensing and regulation for MV power flow, grid synchronization, AC and DC voltage and current closed-loop control, motor field-oriented control
• Develop optimal PWM control strategy for wide-bandgap devices and power electronics hardware
• Define embedded software build and release processes and toolchain
• Hands-on debug embedded software codes on target hardware systems
• Work with a tightly knit, cross-disciplinary team on every aspect of the HPU
• Bring novel solutions to hard problems and challenge the status quo

Requirements:
• All levels available, from recent graduates to 10+ years of experience
• Bachelor's degree in electrical, software, or controls engineering, ideally with power electronics or hardware exposure
• Demonstrated experience writing embedded code that runs on real hardware, through industry, research, or significant project work
• Working knowledge of the physical system your software controls, such as power conversion, motors, or sensing
• Familiarity with SIL/HIL development methods and platforms such as Typhoon HIL, Opal-RT, or Speedgoat
• Knowledge of electrical test equipment and safe handling of high-power systems
• Self-motivated, high-performing, able to self-manage and multi-task, and an excellent communicator

Preferred:
• Hands-on experience with SiC power devices and modules
• Familiarity with MV systems and grid control strategies
• Experience with electrical safety standards in the UL or IEC family
